ValidationRule.description: Prevents DMT Opportunities related to Prospects from being closed as Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "DMT_Opportunity", OR( Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Subsidiary", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Group" ), $Profile.Name != "Desktop Integration", $Profile.Name != "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.DMT_Line_God) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot proceed with the closing process because this opportunity is related to a Prospect
